product_rsc.description: KLOW is a nominal 80 mg research blend containing BPC-157, KPV, TB-500 and GHK-Cu. The source identifies its TB-500 component as Ac-LKKTETQ, the acetylated seven-residue thymosin beta-4 fragment. Review current lot-specific identity and quantitative-content documentation. For laboratory research only; not for human or veterinary use.
